description: What to pay, and where, to buy a gimmeclip account (API key plus $5.00 of credit) or to add credit to the account of the API key in use, in USDC on Base with x402. This tool does not pay: it returns the exact x402 payment requirements (`accepts`) for an HTTP POST that an x402 client (for example x402-fetch) pays and sends with an X-PAYMENT header. Credit is 1.00 to 500 US dollars per top-up.

cents.description: For "credits": how much to add, in US cents.

purpose.description: "account": a new account with its own API key. "credits": more credit for the account of the API key in use.
